Power Transmission
     1. When starting the Tractor, the Multi-
Power Lever should be in ''High'' position,
due to lubrication of various components of
the transmission.

     2. The Multi-Power Lever may be
shifted without disengaging the clutch, allow-
ing you to "shift-on-the-go". When shifting
the Multi-Power Lever, always move the
lever all the way up or down.
